    • Resolution:
      • #multiplex: 8x16 Analog Switch Array Chip CH446Q and 5x24 Analog Switch Array Chip CH446X
        • Recap: 128 analog switches in intersection point of 5x24 matrix consisting of 24 X ports and 5 Y ports, allowing any X port and any Y port to conduct or disconnect/ 2 X ports to conduct to 1 Y port enabling indirect conduction between any two X ports or any two Y ports (CH446X has only 120 analog switches)
        • It's even a #wch #mcu. Clone of MT8816. 3dB rolloff (1/2 the passband) is 50MHz. Which can be considered bandwidth.
